channel.title: Vibe Island Updates
channel.description: Vibe Island - macOS Notch panel for Claude Code

item.title: Version 1.0.5
item.description:
New Features

  • Codex multi-agent support: subagent sessions now appear nested under the parent conversation instead of as separate cards

Improvements

  • Better Codex tool status: tool names now display consistently (e.g. "Read", "Bash", "Edit") with parameter details
  • Codex reasoning text now shown in real-time during thinking phases
  • Reduced phantom session flashes from Codex Desktop title sub-agents

item.title: Version 1.0.4
item.description:
Improvements

  • Smarter hook configuration that adapts to your Claude Code version
  • Improved audio engine stability with Bluetooth audio devices
  • Better Codex terminal jumping in Ghostty and Warp
  • Added Send Feedback button in Settings

Fixes

  • Fixed an issue where older Claude Code versions could reject the entire settings file
  • Fixed payment help not appearing after failed purchases
  • Fixed onboarding button order for overseas users
  • Fixed hook repair status not updating correctly in Settings

item.title: Version 1.0.0
item.description:
Highlights

  • Official 1.0 release with licensing system
  • Complete onboarding experience
  • Edition Card member pass

Sound

  • 8-bit chiptune sound system with real-time synthesis

New CLI Support

  • Cursor Agent integration with approval and jump
  • OpenCode integration (SSE + REST, permission and Q&A)
  • Gemini CLI support

Terminal Support

  • cmux precise jump via Socket JSON-RPC
  • Ghostty improvements (UUID cache, fork auto-detection)
  • Termius and Superset detection
  • Minimized window recovery for all terminals

Improvements

  • Session Switcher (keyboard navigation)
  • Plan Review with feedback input
  • AskUserQuestion GUI interaction
  • Parallel permission approval queue
  • IDE extension auto-install (VS Code, Cursor, Windsurf)
  • Auto-collapse on mouse leave
  • Redesigned Settings panel
  • Customizable keyboard shortcuts

Reliability

  • Network relay for improved license activation
  • Three-layer activation fallback
  • Better error messages for network issues
  • Production-level crash monitoring
  • Memory safety improvements

item.title: Version 0.9.7
item.description:
New Features

  • Usage monitoring: See your Claude API usage (5-hour and 7-day windows) directly in the notch panel header
  • Codex session hooks: More reliable Codex session tracking with explicit start/stop signals (Codex ≥ 0.114.0)
  • Codex thread titles: Session titles now persist across app restarts
  • System notification interception: Captures macOS notification alerts for inline display
  • Inline markdown formatting: Rich text rendering in session messages and approval details

Improvements

  • Improved Codex monitoring reliability with upgraded architecture
  • Codex sessions now restore automatically on app launch
  • Compact layout reduced by 6%
  • Improved Ghostty terminal jump reliability

Fixes

  • Fixed stale accessibility observer causing CPU usage
  • Fixed compact mode bell icon and two-digit session count display
  • Fixed What's New popup fallback parsing
  • Removed stale localhost feed URL from update settings

item.title: Version 0.9.1

item.title: Version 0.9.0
item.description:
New Features

  • Rich approval details — Edit diffs, Write file preview, Bash commands, Read file preview, WebFetch/WebSearch context, and ExitPlanMode plan preview shown directly in the notch panel
  • Completion card — context preview when AI finishes a task, auto-expands for quick review
  • Ghostty split-pane precise jumping — AX-based tab cache enables accurate jump even with multiple splits
  • Session recovery on restart — persistent terminal metadata allows seamless session restore after app restart

Improvements

  • iTerm2 tmux -CC jump speed improved (1370ms → 200ms) via AppleScript pane cache
  • Hover pause: expanded panel stays open while mouse is inside (5s minimum guarantee)
  • DMG installer: pixel art Applications folder icon for better dark background visibility
  • Menu reorganization: Help Improve moved before Quit
  • Debug log noise reduced for lower token consumption

Fixes

  • Ghostty+tmux cold start jump failure resolved
  • Ghostty non-frontmost AXPress now works without flicker
  • Settings toggle no longer resets panel height
  • Daily restart no longer shows unnecessary "restart CLI" prompt
  • Bash approval text wraps naturally with description displayed

item.title: Version 0.8.2
item.description:
Improvements

  • Faster terminal jump with pre-activated app window
  • Smarter Codex idle detection with layered delay for thinking states
  • Ghostty + tmux split pane jumping now at pane-level precision
  • Unified code signing for debug and release builds

Fixes

  • Fixed terminal jump focus being stolen by title updates in tmux
  • Fixed Ghostty + tmux jump timing with retry for set-titles propagation
  • Fixed Ghostty AX failure now falls back to tmux pane check
  • Fixed Codex processing state being skipped by idle fallback
  • Fixed 4 missing UserDefaults keys during bundle ID migration
  • Improved hover behavior — buttons trigger highlight, text area preserved

item.title: Version 0.8.1
item.description:

Improvements

  • Session title persists after /rename in Ghostty — no longer overwritten by new messages

Fixes

  • Fixed false-positive terminal approval detection that could dismiss permission dialogs
  • Improved accessibility action fallback when window activation fails

item.title: Version 0.8.0
item.description:
New Features

  • Smart panel suppression: panel won't auto-expand when your terminal is in the foreground
  • Full i18n support: English, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, and Korean
  • ESC interrupt detection: automatically detects interrupted sessions and shows orange "Interrupted" status
  • Clean/Detailed layout modes: choose your preferred panel style with customizable width
  • Enhanced tmux support: precise pane-level jumping for both tmux -CC and regular tmux
  • Terminal.app precise tab jumping: accurately switch to the correct tab
  • MCP tools display server name instead of generic "MCP" label
  • Improved session titles: shows first user message, aligned with Claude Code's /resume
  • Instant approval detection: faster permission response with precise toolUseId matching
  • Conversation compact notification: auto-expands panel when conversation is compacted

Improvements

  • Hover highlight on approval buttons for better visual feedback
  • Session card interaction refinements with progressive disclosure
  • Updated DMG installer with 3D pixel title effect
  • Restored sessions show "Restart session for live tracking" hint

Fixes

  • Fixed Codex session tracking issues
  • Fixed terminal detection in tmux environments
  • Fixed approval UI being overwritten during parallel tool execution
  • Fixed sessions getting stuck in "Working" state after ESC interrupt
  • Fixed auto-collapse timer with consecutive task completions
  • Improved session stability for restored sessions
  • Fixed smart suppression accuracy across different tabs and panes
